scene: The badger chirrups softly, pointing you toward three peculiar outbound departures.
picture: Flat side view across the departure dock. Far left sits an open-doored garden tram tangled in flowering ivy. Left stands the grandfather holding his bicycle, pet badger perched on his handlebar crate. Centre waits a shiny red retro streetcar. Right sits a ticket booth. Far right, a carved koi boat bobs in canal water.
shown: a moss-covered garden tram waiting open-doored on tracks at the far left
a red retro streetcar ringing its brass bell on tracks at the centre
a carved wooden koi-shaped boat idling at a canal dock on the far right
